title: The Lighthouse of Whispering Sands
setting_summary: A small lighthouse village on a shrinking island where the tide rises a little higher every year, so space and fresh water grow scarce and everyone must share tightly. A strict keeper's ledger decides who gets water, food, and a place to sleep, and the lighthouse bell watches over every rule. The children discover that the island's old stories and the rights of every villager can help them find a fairer way to live before the sea takes the last dry ground.
